macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks rally after weak jobs report
items.summary: The Nasdaq reached a record high while the S&P 500 and Dow also gained after September payroll growth sharply undershot expectations, reducing bets on another Federal Reserve rate hike. The U.S. added 29,000 jobs and unemployment rose to 4.2%.

items.title: Nasdaq hits record high as rate-hike expectations ease
items.summary: U.S. equities climbed as softer employment data fueled expectations that the Federal Reserve may avoid another interest-rate increase later this month. Treasury yields initially fell after the report, while markets continued to monitor elevated bond-market volatility.

items.title: Tesla deliveries beat expectations
items.summary: Tesla reported third-quarter deliveries of 486,532 vehicles, exceeding analysts’ estimate of about 456,000. Tesla shares rose more than 5% in trading following the announcement.

items.title: Nike shares fall after weaker sales outlook
items.summary: Nike shares declined about 5% after the company projected a larger sales decline for the current fiscal year than analysts expected.

items.title: European corporate shares advance on company news
items.summary: Thales gained after securing a major air-surveillance contract with Ireland, Wizz Air rose after reporting a 24.2% year-over-year increase in September passengers, and Julius Baer announced a share buyback of up to 600 million Swiss francs.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $85,000 as crypto market rises
items.summary: Bitcoin climbed roughly 2%–3% over the past 24 hours to about $85,400–$86,200, while the broader crypto market gained around 1%. Ethereum rose above $2,700, and Solana and XRP posted stronger gains; approximately $244 million in short positions were liquidated.

items.title: SEC proposes more flexible crypto custody framework
items.summary: The SEC proposed rules that could allow registered investment advisers and regulated funds to custody crypto assets themselves when eligible custodians are unavailable, while also permitting state trust companies to serve as custodians.

items.title: U.S. states coordinate digital-asset oversight
items.summary: New York and Wyoming signed an agreement to coordinate supervision of crypto firms, including licensing reviews, examinations and enforcement actions.

items.title: EU regulators scrutinize Binance’s MiCA exemption
items.summary: European regulators are reportedly examining Binance’s reliance on the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation’s reverse-solicitation exemption to continue serving some EU customers without full authorization.

items.title: NEAR Intents identifies alleged $3.8 million attacker
items.summary: NEAR Intents said it identified the individual behind an exploit involving approximately $3.8 million and gave the person 48 hours to return the funds under a responsible-disclosure process.

items.title: Cardano ecosystem reports mainnet and partnership developments
items.summary: Cardano-linked projects highlighted the RealFi mainnet launch, SundaeSwap V4, Midnight’s private smart-contract milestone and new enterprise initiatives involving Brazil’s Petrobras. ADA rose about 3.8% over 24 hours.

items.title: Citi raises Bitcoin and Ethereum price targets
items.summary: Citigroup raised its 12-month Bitcoin target from $82,000 to $113,000 and its Ethereum target from $2,240 to $3,028, citing improving market conditions and institutional interest.

items.title: September crypto exploit losses exceed $766 million
items.summary: Crypto hacks and exploits reportedly caused more than $766 million in losses during September, making it the largest monthly loss total of the year.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition launches worldwide
items.summary: Microsoft and The Coalition reportedly launched the Premium Edition of Gears of War: E-Day for Xbox Series X|S and PC, with early access and Unreal Engine 5 features.

items.title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve releases worldwide
items.summary: Bandai Namco reportedly released Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve on PlayStation 5, Xbox and PC, featuring dynamic storms and AI pilot coordination.

items.title: Dynasty Warriors 3 remaster launches
items.summary: Koei Tecmo and Omega Force reportedly released Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered for modern consoles and PC, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5.

items.title: Critical Role joins ROCKBEASTS as co-publisher
items.summary: Critical Role announced a publishing partnership with LICHTHUND for ROCKBEASTS, a story-driven rock-band management RPG planned for release in 2027.

items.title: European authorities target video-game virtual-currency practices
items.summary: The European Commission and national consumer-protection authorities reportedly began coordinated action involving nine major game companies over virtual-currency conversions, monetization practices and refund rights.

items.title: Reigns studio reportedly closes
items.summary: The London-based studio behind the Reigns series has reportedly shut down, marking a notable development for the independent game sector.

items.title: Fortnitemares 2026 shop dates revealed
items.summary: Epic Games reportedly announced Fortnite Fortnitemares 2026 shop dates, including collaborations or content tied to Black Clover, Freddy Krueger and Hollow Knight.

items.title: Invincible VS confirms next DLC fighter
items.summary: Invincible VS reportedly confirmed another playable character for its 3v3 tag fighter, scheduled to arrive in a mid-October update.
